messages:
Omar (Auditor): Hi team — need an evidence package for upcoming SOC2/ISO spot check. Items: RBAC pre/post snapshots for sampled high-priv roles, cloud IAM policy history, KMS rotation timeline including key policy sha256, vuln triage -> incident linkage, SA deprovision proofs, and a signed bundle + verification README. Please map files to control IDs. Req doc: https://files.redwood.example.com/audits/spotcheck-2026

Priya (sec-eng): We can. Quick q: sampling — focused on high-privilege roles and any SAs changed in the window? retention 1y ok?

Omar (Auditor): Yes focused sample. 1 year preferred. Must have UTC (RFC3339) timestamps and manifest signed. KMS rows must include alias, key_id, rotation_version, policy_sha256, and cloudtrail_event_id for replay.

Sanjay (eng-security): Plan: produce RBAC_SAMPLES/ with pre.csv and post.csv (role,principal,type,event_id); IAM_HISTORY/ with versioned exports; KMS_ROTATIONS.csv with the envelope columns; VULN_MAP.csv linking vuln -> jira -> fix_pr -> deploy_ts -> incident_id; SA_DEPROV.csv with PR link + pipeline run URL. We'll include control_map.csv mapping each artifact to control IDs (SOC2 CC6/CC7, ISO A.9 etc.).

Liam (infra): I'll kick export. @oncall-bot start export --bundle=soc2-spot-2026 --include=rbac,iam,kms,vuln,sa

oncall-bot: Export queued job_id=job-2812345670-1, started=2026-07-12T21:10:07Z, target=s3://redwood-audit-exports/spot-2026/job-1. Progress posted here.

Priya (sec-eng): Notes: pre-change snapshot = state <=2m before change event id; post-change = <=2m after. We'll attach PR/commit SHA and CI artifact links for traceability. Manifest will be GPG-signed and include sha256 sums. README will show verify steps (gpg --verify, sha256sum -c) and how to replay CloudTrail events using event IDs.

Sanjay (eng-security): For vuln triage we'll export a compact timeline per vuln: vuln_id,cvss,discover_ts,triage_owner,fix_pr,deploy_ts,incident_id. That should satisfy crosswalk requests.

oncall-bot: job-2812345670-1 update: gather complete. Bundling artifacts. Uploading to s3://redwood-audit-exports/spot-2026/job-1/soc2-spot-bundle.tar.gz

oncall-bot: job-2812345670-1 complete: uploaded soc2-spot-bundle.tar.gz; manifest.sig and manifest.sha256 available. Generating presigned URL.

Liam (infra): Presigned URL (7d): https://s3-presigned.redwood.example.com/spot-2026/job-1/soc2-spot-bundle.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800 (PMed creds).

Omar (Auditor): Downloaded and verified signature + sha256. Initial pass OK. I may have a small follow-up about a KMS policy hash mismatch for one alias — will post details after deep review. Thanks for quick turnaround.

Priya (sec-eng): Thanks — standing by for follow-ups. We can re-run an export with extended retention (3y) if required.
